ZMB.note: The chatbot is one feedback channel, not stated as AI in a body's own work; no other AI named.
The portal takes feedback and complaints, not transactions; no service is stated online.

facts.fact: SMART Zambia Institute says it has developed the Citizens Support Services Portal, taking complaints with a tracking number through portal, SMS, WhatsApp, app and chatbot channels, with the official launch date still to be announced.

systems.platform: portal, email, SMS, voice, WhatsApp, Facebook, mobile app, chatbot
systems.owner: SMART Zambia Institute (E-Government Division, Office of the President)

ZMB.note: The portal is stated developed but not live, so no in-house build gone live is stated.
